# IMPRI - Impact And Policy Research Institute

> IMPRI is India's leading policy research institute offering online courses, fellowships, and research across public policy, governance, and development sectors.

IMPRI (Impact And Policy Research Institute) based in New Delhi provides comprehensive policy education and research through WebPolicyLearning courses and specialized fellowship programs. The institute operates multiple research centers focusing on international relations, environment, urban studies, gender, health, and human development.

## Key Topics

- Policy Research
- Public Policy
- Governance
- Fellowship Programs
- Online Courses
- Policy Analysis
- Sustainable Development
- Gender & Social Inclusion
- Climate Change
- Urban Policy
- Health Policy
- International Relations
- Youth Leadership
- Women Leadership
- Professional Development

## Core Programs & Fellowships

- [IMPRI Fellowships](https://www.impriindia.com/fellowships): IMPRI fellowship programs including LPPYF and EPAYF for policy leadership
- [Public Policy Courses](https://www.impriindia.com/public-policy-courses): Public policy courses and fellowships including YWLPPF and LPPYF programs
- [Data & Impact](https://www.impriindia.com/data-courses): Data analytics courses including Power BI and DAPRF fellowship for impact
- [Gender & Social Inclusion](https://www.impriindia.com/gender-courses): Gender and social inclusion courses with YWLPPF fellowship program

## Specialized Course Areas

- [Environment Policy & Climate Change](https://www.impriindia.com/environment-courses): Environment policy and climate change courses with EPAYF fellowship
- [Urban Policy And Regional Studies](https://www.impriindia.com/urban-courses): Urban policy and city planning courses with UPLGYF fellowship program
- [Health Policy & Governance](https://www.impriindia.com/health-courses): Health policy and governance courses on public health and sector management
- [Foreign Policy And Strategic Affairs](https://www.impriindia.com/foreign-policy-courses): Foreign policy and strategic affairs courses with geopolitics fellowship
- [All Courses](https://www.impriindia.com/courses): Catalog of WebPolicyLearning courses in public policy and data analytics

## Research Publications & Outputs

- [Reports](https://www.impriindia.com/research/reports): IMPRI research reports on India-Malaysia relations and sustainable development
- [Policy Briefs](https://www.impriindia.com/research/policy-briefs): IMPRI policy briefs on India-EU relations, climate change, entrepreneurship
- [Books](https://www.impriindia.com/research/books): IMPRI published books on urban development, foreign policy, and governance
- [Journal Articles](https://www.impriindia.com/research/journal-articles): IMPRI journal articles on Pakistan politics, foreign policy, and governance
- [Working Papers](https://www.impriindia.com/research/working-papers): IMPRI working papers on PCOS policy, gender health, and education

## Research & Analysis

- [Thematic Areas](https://www.impriindia.com/research/thematic-areas): IMPRI research thematic areas covering agriculture, economy, environment
- [Insights](https://www.impriindia.com/insights): IMPRI policy analysis blog on governance, taxation, and environmental policy
- [In News](https://www.impriindia.com/research/in-news): IMPRI research featured in news on economy, tariffs, and policy analysis
- [Commentary](https://www.impriindia.com/research/commentary): IMPRI policy commentary on governance, international relations, and law

## Community & Updates

- [Newsletter](https://www.impriindia.com/production/newsletter): Weekly IMPRI newsletter with events, activities, and research publications
- [Home](https://www.impriindia.com): IMPRI homepage offering online courses, fellowships, and research on policy issues
